zh-CN.title: 锁定消息入口更直接
items: 点击整条锁定栏即可查看锁定消息，矮屏时入口收进会话顶部菜单旁
修复平板导航头像居中，矮屏隐藏头像并默认折叠输入框

en.title: Quicker access to pinned messages
items: Open pinned messages from the entire bar, or a header lock button on short screens
Center tablet navigation avatars and simplify navigation and composing on short screens
